approval_boundary: Static illustrated concepts only. No native mesh, continuous motion, collisions, inventory conservation, recipe execution or runtime conformity approval.
authority: Latest exact owner-selected conveyor R1 and core R4; current 36-cell matrix. The authored 13-cylinder target applies only to the additional 06 fishing-line view study, not the original footage or all conveyor modules.
scope: U01–U03 typed utility feeder and timber/mineral processing connections.
passing_observations: Timber and mineral feeder bins remain distinct; the wrong-class example is held by a real gate immediately outside the saw input.
The saw and parked quarry/tower retain their visual identities.
Wood-to-plank and stone-to-block intended forms are labelled; front C1 and worker access are visible.

defects.finding: Elevated conveyor runs stand on thin timber legs rather than the selected enclosed orange/blue support family.
defects.repair: Replace only conveyor support geometry with enclosed, supported rise/adapter housings matching the approved kit; preserve machine timber frames.

defects.finding: TIMBER SELECTED and MINERALS SELECTED still show a vertical silver gate across the selected hopper mouth. An arrow sign changes the label but does not visibly open the carrying path.
defects.repair: Raise, swing or retract the selected gate clear of the carrying surface, leaving the non-selected class physically closed. Preserve the wrong-class stop at the saw throat.

defects.finding: The raw-stone bridge terminates against the winch/tower base, and the finished-block bridge meets beside the vehicle track/body without visible processing apertures. Typed signs alone do not show a physically connected processor.
defects.repair: Expose short distinct typed input and output sleeve/aperture connections at the parked processing body, with supported matched transfer plates; do not feed the winch or treads. Preserve the blue vehicle and tower identity.

defects.finding: The bound wood props read roughly 0.35–0.43 of C1 height in the wide timber panel, compared with about 0.26 in the owner-selected core R4. These are approximate projected comparisons, not world dimensions.
defects.repair: Calibrate ordinary bound wood units down toward the exact core R4 reference while keeping C1, the feeder and saw dimensions. Use more compact units for stock piles instead of enlarging a unit.

matrix_statuses.U01: HOLD: selected gate does not visibly clear the path; support style and wood scale drift.
matrix_statuses.U02: Saw route and physical wrong-class stop visible; support style and wood scale correction required.
matrix_statuses.U03: HOLD: typed input/output apertures not visible at the parked processing body.

next_action: Repair the selected feeder gate states, dock sleeves, conveyor housings and ordinary wood props without redesigning the machines.
